reading: The sketch is a team members admin page: a heading and subtitle, an "+Invite" button, a filter/search toolbar, a bulk-action bar for selected rows, a large data table of 10 team members with avatars/roles/status/usage, an open status-filter dropdown menu overlaying the table, and a pagination bar at the bottom. All text content and styling come directly from the typed notes attached to each stroke group; the page overall uses pale grey background, Helvetica type, and dark navy text.
